name: BioGRID_get_interactions
description: Query experimentally validated protein and genetic interactions from BioGRID. Results use the official start/max pagination: begin with offset=0 and continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true. For physical/genetic client-side filters, offset advances through upstream records and a page may contain fewer than limit matching records. Requires a free BIOGRID_API_KEY.

gene_names.description: List of gene names or protein identifiers (e.g., ['TP53', 'BRCA1', 'MYC']). Accepts official gene symbols.

gene_name.description: Alias for gene_names: single gene symbol (e.g., 'TP53'). Converted to gene_names list automatically.

organism.description: Organism name (e.g., 'Homo sapiens', 'Mus musculus') or NCBI taxonomy ID (e.g., '9606' for human, '10090' for mouse). Default: 9606 (human)

interaction_type.description: Type of interaction: 'physical' (protein-protein), 'genetic' (epistasis, synthetic lethality), 'both' (all interactions)

evidence_types.description: Filter by evidence types (e.g., ['Affinity Capture-MS', 'Two-hybrid'] for physical, ['Synthetic Lethality', 'Dosage Rescue'] for genetic). Leave empty for all evidence types.

limit.description: Maximum upstream interactions to scan on this page (default: 100, max: 9999; one extra record is fetched to prove whether another page exists).

offset.description: Zero-based BioGRID upstream record offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

throughput.description: Filter by throughput: 'low' (low-throughput studies), 'high' (high-throughput screens), or leave empty for all

BIOGRID_ACCESS_KEY.purpose: Retrieve protein–protein and genetic interaction networks.
BIOGRID_ACCESS_KEY.without: BioGRID tools are blocked without it. The key is free.

oneOf.description: BioGRID API response keyed by interaction ID. Each value is an interaction object.

name: BioGRID_get_chemical_interactions
description: Query BioGRID interactions for specific genes/proteins, with recoverable official start/max pagination through offset and metadata.next_offset. Important: BioGRID does not support chemical-only queries and silently ignores chemicalList, so gene_names is required in practice; prefer ChEMBL or DGIdb for drug-protein queries. Requires a free BIOGRID_API_KEY.

gene_names.description: List of gene names to query for chemical interactions (e.g., ['TP53', 'EGFR', 'AKT1']). Leave empty to search by chemical only.

chemical_names.description: List of chemical compound names (e.g., ['Aspirin', 'Metformin', 'Imatinib']). Leave empty to search by gene only.

organism.description: NCBI taxonomy ID (e.g., '9606' for human, '10090' for mouse). Default: 9606

interaction_action.description: Filter by interaction action type (e.g., 'inhibitor', 'activator', 'antagonist', 'agonist'). Leave empty for all actions.

limit.description: Maximum upstream interactions on this page (default: 100, max: 9999).

offset.description: Zero-based BioGRID upstream record offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

include_evidence.description: Include detailed evidence and publication information (default: true)

oneOf.description: BioGRID chemical-protein interaction data keyed by interaction ID.

name: BioGRID_search_by_pubmed
description: Retrieve BioGRID interactions curated from PubMed studies with recoverable official start/max pagination. Begin at offset=0 and continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true; a large paper is no longer silently limited to its first page. Requires a free BIOGRID_API_KEY.

pubmed_ids.description: List of PubMed IDs to query (e.g., ['12345678', '87654321']). Can be numeric or string format.

organism.description: NCBI taxonomy ID to filter interactions by organism (e.g., '9606' for human, '559292' for S. cerevisiae). Leave empty for all organisms.

include_evidence.description: Include detailed evidence information (experimental systems, methods). Default: true

limit.description: Maximum upstream interactions on this page (default: 1000, max: 9999).

offset.description: Zero-based BioGRID upstream record offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

oneOf.description: Interaction data from specified publications including genes, interaction types, experimental methods, and evidence details
Empty array when no interactions found for the given PubMed IDs

name: BioGRID_get_ptms
description: Retrieve post-translational-modification interaction records for proteins from BioGRID with recoverable official start/max pagination. Begin at offset=0 and continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true. Requires a free BIOGRID_API_KEY.

gene_names.description: List of gene names to query for PTMs (e.g., ['TP53', 'AKT1', 'EGFR', 'ERK1']). Accepts official gene symbols.

organism.description: NCBI taxonomy ID (e.g., '9606' for human, '10090' for mouse). Default: 9606

ptm_type.description: Filter by PTM types (e.g., ['Phosphorylation', 'Ubiquitination', 'Acetylation', 'Methylation', 'Sumoylation']). Leave empty for all PTM types.

residue.description: Filter by specific amino acid residue (e.g., 'S' for serine, 'T' for threonine, 'Y' for tyrosine). Leave empty for all residues.

include_enzymes.description: Include information about enzymes responsible for the PTM (kinases, ligases, etc.). Default: true

include_evidence.description: Include experimental evidence and publication details. Default: true

limit.description: Maximum upstream PTM interaction records on this page (default: 500, max: 9999).

offset.description: Zero-based BioGRID upstream record offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

oneOf.description: BioGRID PTM data keyed by interaction ID. Each value contains modification details, interactors, and evidence.
